body: Added to the backlog as a third way to build for full screen: a small dock of tool icons that opens out under the pointer on a computer. For a phone, which has no pointer to hover, I noted a small handle at the edge that a tap opens as a first idea. It sits with your earlier full-screen question in `docs/decisions/verse-tap-and-hold.md` ①; left open until there is a rough build to try.
